attributes.action: Introduce a Right to Choose scheme for Autism and ADHD assessments in Scotland
attributes.additional_details: Scotland has no Right to Choose pathway for autism or ADHD assessments, while eligible patients in England can choose an NHS-funded provider.  Long waits can leave individuals and families struggling without answers or appropriate support. We ask the Scottish Government to introduce a Scottish Right to Choose scheme, giving people greater choice and helping reduce waiting times.
attributes.background: Call on the Scottish Government to introduce a Right to Choose scheme for Autism and ADHD assessments, giving eligible people greater choice of NHS-funded providers and helping reduce lengthy waiting times that are leaving individuals and families struggling without answers or support.

rejection.details:
This is, as your text recognises, a matter for the Scottish Government - this petitions system is for petitions aimed at the *UK* Government or Parliament.

You may want to start a petition at the Scottish Parliament petitions site:
